about: Every file, dataset and tool the training of hey-lampas.json used, with its source, its licence and the licence's own words, read at the source on the date given (story mw-rdpwdp1.1). The model's weights are ours (MIT), made by scripts/wake-probe from the data below. The road-like noise and the room echo are made by scripts/wake-probe/probe.mjs itself, from no recording. Nothing below ships except the model.

notUsed.name: Piper en_US-libritts_r-medium
notUsed.why: The story named it, and docs/wake-word-engines.md had it as permissive from its data (LibriTTS-R, CC BY 4.0). But its own card says "Fine-tuned from English lessac medium on train-clean-360", and the lessac medium card names its data as the Blizzard 2013 Lessac recordings, whose licence is for "Research Purposes" only and "excludes ... using the Materials for any commercial purpose, including the development, marketing, commercialisation, sale or licencing of voice synthesis or speech recognition products or services". So its weights are NOT CLEAN under this story's rules, and the VCTK VITS voice took its place.
